title: WheatTraitMap: A Trait Discovery Atlas for Wheat
description:
WheatTraitMap is a physical genomic atlas and web database of wheat trait loci (QTL, marker-trait associations, QTN and genes) curated from the published literature, with positions on IWGSC RefSeq v1.0, v2.1 and 15 pangenome assemblies, and online tools for meta-QTL and meta-GWAS analysis, marker lookup, primer design, gene and expression analysis, GO/KEGG enrichment and gene networks.

This archive holds the complete website (folder web/), the curation material (curation/), data files (data/) and processing scripts (scripts/) for the release named in the version field. Live website: https://neerajvasistha-netize.github.io/WheatNHR-Atlas/ (mirror: https://wheattraitmap.neeraj-vasistha.workers.dev/).

Locus information is drawn from the published studies cited in each record; please also cite the original study for any locus you use.
